query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
            length(coalesce(content->>'text',    '')) +
            length(coalesce(content->>'code',    '')) +
            length(coalesce(content->>'caption', '')) +
            length(coalesce(content->>'name',    '')) +
            length(coalesce(content->>'url',     '')) +
            chunk_cells_char_count(content)
        ), 0) AS "char_count!"
        FROM document_chunks
        WHERE document_id = $1
